props.title: For agencies and studios that need engineering they can vouch for.
props.lede: Our standards are published, so you can hold us to them in front of your own client. That is the point of partnering with us rather than subcontracting blind.

props.heading: Three ways we work with you.

cards.title: White label
cards.body: We build under your brand, to your standards, and stay invisible to your client.

cards.title: Overflow capacity
cards.body: A reviewed, typed increment when your own team is at capacity — not bodies on a bench.

cards.title: Referral
cards.body: You send work that is outside your scope; we do the same in return.
